scripts.cloudflare:build: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare populateCache local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:preview: npm run cloudflare:build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.sites:build: npm run cloudflare:build && npm run sites:stage
scripts.sites:stage: node scripts/stage-sites-build.mjs && wrangler deploy dist/server-source/index.js --dry-run --outdir dist/server --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/finalize-sites-build.mjs
